## Problem 1
```{r}
transit_sea =
  read_csv(
    "./data/NYC_Transit_Subway_Entrance_And_Exit_Data.csv",
    na = c("NA", ".", ""),
    col_types = cols(
      Route1 = "c", Route2 = "c", Route3 = "c", Route4 = "c", Route5 = "c", Route6 = "c", Route7 = "c", Route8 = "c", Route9 = "c", Route10 = "c", Route11 = "c")) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  select(
    line, station_name, station_latitude, station_longitude, route1:route11, entry, vending, entrance_type, ada) |>
  mutate(entry = case_match(entry, "YES" ~ TRUE, "NO" ~ FALSE))

dim(transit_sea)
```

The dataset contains variables including station names, locations, routes served, entrance type, vending availability, and ADA compliance. Each row represent one entrance or exit. I cleaned the data by standardizign variable names with clean_names, selecting relevant variables, reading routes variables as character, and converting entry from YES?NO to a logical variable. The dataset has `r nrow(transit_sea)` rows and `r ncol(transit_sea)` columns. The data is not tidy because the routes are spread in 11 columns rather than being in a single one. 

### Problem 1 questions
```{r}
# distinct stations
transit_sea |>
  select(station_name, line) |>
  distinct()

# ADA compliant stations
transit_sea |>
  filter(ada == TRUE) |>
  select(station_name, line) |>
  distinct()

# proportion of entrances/exits without vending that allow entry
transit_sea |>
  filter(vending == "NO") |>
  pull(entry) |>
  mean()
```

There are 465 unique stations based on station name and subway line, of which 84 are ADA compliant. Among entrances and exits without vending machines, 0.377 allow entry.

```{r}
# stations that serve the A train
transit_sea |>
  pivot_longer(
    route1:route11,
    names_to = "route_num",
    values_to = "route") |>
  filter(route == "A") |>
  select(station_name, line) |>
  distinct()

# ...of those, the ADA compliant ones
transit_sea |>
  pivot_longer(
    route1:route11,
    names_to = "route_num",
    values_to = "route") |>
  filter(route == "A", ada == TRUE) |>
  select(station_name, line) |>
  distinct()
```
After restructuring the data to separate route numbers and names, I found that 60 unique stations serve the A train, 17 of which are ADA compliant.
